replies.author: Vobaseball12
replies.body:
Hello PepaPig_. I am glad that you now regret that you hacked, and I strongly advise never doing it again, but I have to inform you that you have not served/waited enough to be appealed. Therefore, this appeal is denied. 

I suggest trying again in 2-4 months.

Regards,
Vobaseball12
